api.name: Abs
api.description: Returns the absolute value of a number.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to take the absolute value of.

returns.description: The absolute value of the given number.

remarks: Commonly used to compare magnitudes, for example a distance, a speed, or a per-axis difference between two vectors.

api.name: AbsAngleClamp180
api.description: Returns abs angle value clamped between [0,180].

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The angle to clamp, in degrees.

returns.description: The angle as an absolute value in the range 0 to 180.

remarks: Used on a single angle component, such as roll or yaw, to test how far it has deviated from level regardless of direction.

api.name: AbsAngleClamp360
api.description: Returns <angle> as a value in the range of 0 and 360 degrees.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The angle to wrap, in degrees.

returns.description: The angle wrapped into the range 0 to 360.

api.example: model.angles = ( model.angles[0], AbsAngleClamp360( model.angles[1] + n_yaw_delta ), model.angles[2] );
remarks: Typically wraps a yaw that has been incremented by player input so that it stays within a single revolution.

api.name: ACos
api.description: Returns an angle corresponding to a particular cosine value.

api.name: AddAwarenessIndicator
api.description: Draw an awareness indicator.

api.name: AddBoltedFXExclusionVolume
api.description: Create a bolted volume that will exclude FX that are flagged as "Respect Exclusion Volumes". Returns volume ID.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client to create the volume on.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to attach the volume to.

parameters.name: tagName
parameters.description: The tag to use as the volume's origin.

parameters.name: halfExtents
parameters.description: The half extents of the box, given as half of the volume's full dimensions.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: An offset from the tag name for the volume's origin; default is 0 0 0.

returns.description: The ID of the created exclusion volume.

remarks: Used on moving geometry such as trains and vehicles so that effects are suppressed inside the vehicle's volume.
The returned volume ID is stored on the entity so the volume can be referenced later.

api.name: AddDuplicateRenderOption
api.description: Add a duplicate render option for the entity.

parameters.name: dupeType
parameters.description: this is one of [DR_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER|DR_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER_DUPLICATE|DR_TYPE_OFFSCREEN], as defined in _duplicaterender.csc. Sets the duplicate type of this call.

parameters.name: dupeMethod
parameters.description: this is one of [DR_CULL_ALWAYS|DR_CULL_NEVER], as defined in _duplicaterender.csc. Sets the render method of this call.

parameters.name: mappedMaterialId
parameters.description: This is the mapped material id.

parameters.name: dupeCull
parameters.description: this is one of [DR_METHOD_OFF|DR_METHOD_DEFAULT_MATERIAL|DR_METHOD_THERMAL_MATERIAL|DR_METHOD_CUSTOM_MATERIAL|DR_METHOD_FORCE_CUSTOM_MATERIAL], as defined in _duplicaterender.csc. Sets the render method of this call.

api.example: self AddDuplicateRenderOption( type, method, materialId, culling );
remarks: Called once per render option in a duplicate render filter, driven by the filter's parallel type, value and culling arrays.
When no custom material applies, a material ID of -1 is passed.

api.name: AddFriendlyScrambler
api.description: Adds new friendly scrambler to the compass.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose compass the scrambler is added to.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: will be used to remove the scrambler (integer).

remarks: The handle passed here is stored alongside the scrambler so the compass entry can be removed later.
Called on each local player that should see the scrambler on their compass.

api.name: AddFXExclusionVolume
api.description: Create a volume that will exclude FX that are flagged as "Respect Exclusion Volumes". Returns volume ID.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client to create the volume on.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The rotation angles of the volume.

parameters.name: halfExtents
parameters.description: The half extents of the volume.

api.name: AddSensorGrenadeArea
api.description: Adds new sensor grenade radius indicator to the compass.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose compass the sensor area is added to.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: will be used to remove the sensor.

remarks: Called on the owner of the sensor grenade so the radius shows on that player's compass.

api.name: AddZombieBoxWeapon
api.description: Adds a zombie box weapon.

parameters.name: weaponModelName
parameters.description: The model name of the weapon.

parameters.name: isDualWield
parameters.description: True if the weapon is dual wield, false otherwise.

remarks: The model and dual wield flag are normally read straight off the weapon, as weapon.worldmodel and weapon.isdualwield.

api.name: AimingAtFriendly
api.description: Returns true if localclient 0 has crosshairs on friendly.

api.name: AllocateSoundRandoms
api.description: Allocate a pool of random sounds.
remarks: Called once during sound setup with the number of randoms that are not handled by script threads.

api.name: AllowActionSlotInput
api.description: Allows action slot input for the given local client.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Client number of the controller you to enable the action slots.

remarks: Seen at the start of a game mode or during end game flow, where the action slots must remain usable.

api.name: AllowRoundAnimation
api.description: sets the allow round animation flag to enabled or disabled.

api.name: AllowScoreboard
api.description: Sets whether the scoreboard is allowed for the given local client.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client to set the scoreboard state for.

remarks: Observed only with 0, to suppress the scoreboard in modes that use their own UI.

api.name: AngleClamp180
api.description: Returns angle value clamped between [-180,180].

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The angle to clamp, in degrees.

returns.description: The angle clamped to the range -180 to 180.

remarks: Applied per component when a whole angles vector needs clamping.
Often wrapped around AngleLerp so an interpolated yaw stays in the signed range.

api.name: AngleLerp
api.description: Returns <angle> lerped angle value.

returns.description: The interpolated angle.

remarks: Used to ease an angle towards a target over successive frames, with a small fraction such as 0.15.

api.name: AnglesToForward
api.description: Returns the forward vector corresponding to a set of angles.

returns.description: The forward direction vector for the given angles.

remarks: Frequently paired with AnglesToUp to supply the forward and up vectors that PlayFX and effect helpers expect.

api.name: AnglesToRight
api.description: Returns the right vector corresponding to a set of angles.

returns.description: The right direction vector for the given angles.

remarks: Used with AnglesToForward and AnglesToUp to build a full orientation basis, and to offset positions sideways from an entity.

api.name: AnglesToUp
api.description: Returns the up vector corresponding to a set of angles.

returns.description: The up direction vector for the given angles.

remarks: Usually computed alongside AnglesToForward, since effect functions take a forward and an up vector together.

api.name: AnimGetChildAt
api.description: Gets the child animation name at the given index.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to query.

returns.name: childAnim
returns.description: The child animation name.

api.name: AnimGetNumChildren
api.description: Gets the number of child animations for the given animation.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to query.

returns.name: numChildren
returns.description: The number of child animations.

api.name: AnimScripted
api.description: Runs an animscript on an entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to run the animscript on.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The starting position of the animscript.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The starting angles of the animscript.

api.example:
v_angles = ( isdefined( v_origin_or_ent.angles ) ? v_origin_or_ent.angles : ( 0, 0, 0 ) );
self AnimScripted( ANIM_NOTIFY, v_origin_or_ent.origin, v_angles, animation, n_blend_in, n_rate );

api.name: AreMeshesStreamed
api.description: Returns true if this entity's meshes are streamed in.

api.name: AreTexturesStreamed
api.description: Returns true if this entity's textures are streamed in.

api.name: Array
api.description: Creates an array.

parameters.name: members
parameters.description: Zero or more entries to populate the array with.

returns.name: array
returns.description: The created array.

api.name: ArrayCombine
api.description: Combines two arrays and returns the result as a new array.

parameters.name: allowdupes
parameters.description: Whether to allow duplicate entries instead of pruning them.

parameters.name: preserve_keys
parameters.description: Whether to preserve string keys instead of renumbering.

remarks: Commonly used to merge results from repeated lookups, such as several struct or entity queries, into one array.
Both flags are usually passed as 0, giving a renumbered array with duplicates pruned.

api.name: ArrayCopy
api.description: Returns a copy of an array.
remarks: Often used to iterate a copy with foreach while the original array is being modified inside the loop.
Also used when returning a cached level array so callers cannot alter the cached copy.

api.name: ArrayGetClosest
api.description: Returns the entity/vector that is closest to the <origin> from the <array>.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The origin to get closest from.

parameters.name: dist
parameters.description: The minimum distance to check when finding closest (has to be positive).

remarks: Typically called with an entity or struct origin against an array of structs, models, or local players.
The optional distance argument is used to reject anything beyond a cutoff, for example a culling distance read from a dvar.

api.name: ArrayGetFarthest
api.description: Returns the entity/vector that is farthest to the <origin> from the <array>.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The origin to get farthest from.

parameters.name: dist
parameters.description: The maximum distance when finding farthest (has to be positive).

api.name: ArrayInsert
api.description: Inserts a value into an array at a given index, shifting later entries along.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: index at which to insert the value (must be an integer) - moves existing entries as required.

remarks: Used to keep an array in sorted order by inserting at the position found while scanning it.
Passing the array's size as the index appends the value to the end.

api.name: ArrayIntersect
api.description: Returns an array of values that are present in both arrays.

parameters.name: matchKeys
parameters.description: Optionally returns an array of matching key/value pairs from the two input arrays (preserving the keys).

api.name: ArrayRemoveIndex
api.description: Remove a value from an array at a given index.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The index or key of the value to remove.

parameters.name: preserve_keys
parameters.description: Whether to preserve the existing keys instead of renumbering.

remarks: The index may be an integer or a string key, matching how the array was built.
Usually called with 0 so the remaining entries are renumbered, or with the argument omitted.

api.name: ArrayRemoveValue
api.description: Remove a value from an array (may affect multiple indexes).

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to remove, which may be undefined.

parameters.name: preserve_keys
parameters.description: Whether to preserve the existing keys instead of renumbering.

remarks: Widely used to unregister an entity or struct from a tracking array, often passing self as the value.
Passing undefined as the value strips empty entries from an array.

api.name: ASin
api.description: Returns an angle corresponding to a particular sin value.

api.name: ASMGetCurrentState
api.description: Gets the current ASM state name.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose animation state machine is queried.

returns.description: The name of the current ASM state.

remarks: Used to branch on the animation state an AI is currently in, for example before playing secondary animations.

api.name: ASMGetStatus
api.description: Gets the current ASM status.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose animation state machine is queried.

api.name: ASMIsAimLayerActive
api.description: Returns whether the ASM aim layer is active.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose animation state machine is queried.

returns.description: Whether the aim layer is currently active.

remarks: Checked alongside ASMIsShootLayerActive when deciding whether an AI may play a secondary animation.

api.name: ASMIsShootLayerActive
api.description: Returns whether the ASM shoot layer is active.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose animation state machine is queried.

returns.description: Whether the shoot layer is currently active.

remarks: Checked alongside ASMIsAimLayerActive when deciding whether an AI may play a secondary animation.

api.name: ASMIsTerminating
api.description: Returns whether the ASM is terminating.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose animation state machine is queried.

returns.description: Whether the animation state machine is terminating.

remarks: Used to skip work while an AI's animation state machine is shutting down.

api.name: Assert
api.description: Assert that the given statement is correct. The function will throw a script error if this is false.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: statement that is asserted to be correct.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: string describing the nature of the assert.

remarks: By far the most common use is a definedness check on a parameter or a level field before it is used.
The optional message argument explains what the assert is guarding.

api.name: AssertMsg
api.description: Throws a script error with the given message.
remarks: Used in unreachable branches, such as the default case of a lookup, where the message is built from the offending value.

api.name: AssociativeArray
api.description: Creates an array associatively from key-value pairs.

parameters.name: keyValuePairs
parameters.description: Zero or more alternating arguments of keys and values (i.e. key_1, value_1). The amount of arguments passed must be even.

returns.name: array
returns.description: The created array.

api.name: ATan
api.description: Returns an angle corresponding to a particular tangential value.

returns.description: The angle, in degrees, whose tangent is the given value.

remarks: Observed converting a height over distance ratio into a pitch angle, then offsetting it from 90 degrees.

api.name: Attach
api.description: Attach a model to an entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to attach the model to.

parameters.name: tagname
parameters.description: The tag to attach the model to.

remarks: Widely used to build up character models from parts, such as helmets, heads and weapon world models.
An empty tag string is common when the model should follow the entity itself rather than a specific tag.

api.name: AttachWeapon
api.description: Attaches a weapon to the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to attach the weapon to.

parameters.name: renderoptions
parameters.description: The render options for the weapon.

remarks: Called on a character model in end game and customization flows to show the weapon it is holding.
The render options and attachment variations are usually passed together, or both omitted.

api.name: BeamKill
api.description: Kill the previously launched beam.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client the beam was launched on.

remarks: Pairs with BeamLaunch, taking the handle that call returned.
The handle is normally cached on the entity or on a beam struct so it can be killed later.

api.name: BeamLaunch
api.description: Launch this beam and return the internal handle.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Local client on which to play the beam.

parameters.name: tagFrom
parameters.description: The tag on the originating entity to start from.

parameters.name: entityTo
parameters.description: The target entity, or undefined for a beam with no target.

parameters.name: tagTo
parameters.description: The tag on the target entity, or "none" when there is no target.

parameters.name: beam
parameters.description: The name of the beam definition to launch.

returns.description: The handle of the launched beam.

api.example: self.beam_id = BeamLaunch( localClientNum, self, "tag_origin", ai_target, str_tag, "electric_arc_beam_electroball" );
remarks: The returned handle must be kept so the beam can be stopped later with BeamKill.
For a beam with no target, undefined is passed as the target entity and "none" as the target tag.

api.name: BlurAndTint_FX
api.description: Enables or disables the screen blur and tint effect for a local client.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client to apply the effect to.
Whether to enable (1) or disable (0) the effect.
parameters.name: enable
level
parameters.description: The blur level to apply when enabling the effect.

remarks: Used by the player camera blur client field handler, passing 1 with a blur level to enable and 0 to disable.

api.name: Box
api.description: Debug instrument.

api.name: BulletTrace
api.description: Performs a bullet trace between two points.

returns.description: An array of trace results, including keys such as "fraction", "position" and "normal".

remarks: The returned array is read with string keys such as "fraction", "position" and "normal".
Corpus calls almost always pass 0 for hitCharacters and the tracing entity itself as ignoreEnt.

api.name: BulletTracer
api.description: Creates a bullet tracer from the start point to the end point.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The starting point of the bullet tracer.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The end point of the bullet tracer.

remarks: Used by ambient battle scripts to draw stray tracers toward a randomized target point.

api.name: CameraForceDisableScriptCam
api.description: Disable the script cam from client script.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose script camera is being overridden.

parameters.name: disable
parameters.description: Whether to disable the script camera (1) or re-enable it (0).

remarks: Corpus calls pass 1 to force the script camera off and 0 to release the override.

api.name: CameraSetUpdateCallback
api.description: Set the function that will get called during the camera update.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose camera update is being hooked.

parameters.name: function
parameters.description: a function pointer to a function that will get called during the camera update, the function should set the scr cam.

remarks: Calling it with no argument clears a previously set callback.

api.name: CaptureFrame
api.description: Captures the current frame into the given code image, which must already have been created with CreateSceneCodeImage.

parameters.description: The local client to capture the frame for.

remarks: Always immediately preceded by CreateSceneCodeImage with the same image name, and the image is then bound with SetFilterPassCodeTexture.
The captured image is released later with FreeCodeImage.

api.name: Ceil
api.description: Returns the ceiling of floating point value <a>. This effectively rounds up Ceil(2.7) == 3, Ceil(3.9) == 4.
remarks: Corpus calls wrap the result in int() when an integer is needed.

api.name: Circle
api.description: Debug instrument.

api.name: CleanupSpawnedDynEnts
api.description: Removed all dyn ents that were dynamically spawned (gib pieces, destructible parts, etc).
remarks: Called during level or round restarts to clear dynents left over from gibbing and destruction.

api.name: ClearAlternateAimParams
api.description: Forces the local player to use default values for aim assist.  Only works in zombie/campaign mode. Can only be called on players.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to restore default aim assist for.

remarks: Pairs with SetAlternateAimParams, and is used to end aim assist changes from perks and gadgets such as Deadshot Daiquiri and Overdrive.

api.name: ClearAnim
api.description: Sets an animation's goal weight to zero over the specified time.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity playing the animation.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation or animtree node to clear.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The blending time, in seconds, over which the weight drops to zero.

remarks: Accepts either an animtree node (%generic::faces) or an animation name string.
Commonly used to clear the previously played facial animation before setting a new one, with a short blend time.

api.name: ClearExtraCam
api.description: Finds the extracam associated with an entity and removes it.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The extra-cam camera entity.

remarks: Called on the camera entity itself, typically when tearing down a level's extra cameras.

api.name: ClearMaterialOverride
api.description: Clears the material override.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to clear the material override on.

remarks: Only observed once, on a player, in the shared audio script.

api.name: ClearNearestEnemyScrambler
api.description: Clears the closest enemy scrambler from the compass.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose compass is being updated.

remarks: Used by the scrambler script when a player leaves the scrambler's area of influence.

api.name: ClearStepTriggerSound
api.description: Clears the sound triggered by steps.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to clear the step trigger sound for.

remarks: Only observed in the shared audio script, on the player associated with a footstep sound trigger.

api.name: ClearStreamerRequest
api.description: Clear a hint from a request slot (0-7).
remarks: Pairs with SetStreamerRequest, which fills the same slot with a hint.

api.name: ClientHasSnapshot
api.description: Returns true if client has recieved a snapshot from the server.

returns.description: Whether the given local client has received a snapshot from the server.

remarks: Typically used in a wait loop during client initialization, to hold script until the client's first snapshot arrives.

api.name: CloseFile
api.description: Closes an open file.

api.name: CloseLUIMenu
api.description: Close the LUI menu specified.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Number of the local client on the machine.

remarks: Pairs with CreateLUIMenu, whose returned menu index is stored on an entity or on level and passed back here.

api.name: Closer
api.description: Tests which of two points is the closest. Returns true if point a is closer to the reference than point b.

api.name: Codcaster_Keyline_Enable
api.description: Enable or disable the CODCaster Keyline effect.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to enable or disable the keyline effect on.

remarks: Only observed in the duplicate render manager, disabling the keyline on a player.

api.name: CodeGetUIModelClientField
api.description: Gets the value for a given player uimodel client field.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to read the field from.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The dotted UI model client field path.

remarks: The field name is a dotted UI model path, and the result is used directly as a boolean condition in the corpus.

api.name: Codeplaypostfxbundle
api.description: Displays a postfx on the screen.

api.name: Codestoppostfxbundle
api.description: Ends a postfx.

api.name: CombineAngles
api.description: Returns angles b reoriented by angles a.

parameters.name: anglesA
parameters.description: Angles representing the orientation in which to place <angles b>.

api.name: Cos
api.description: Returns the cos of an angle.

returns.description: The cosine of the angle.

remarks: Usually paired with Sin to build a position offset or a rotation on a circle.

api.name: CreateDynEntAndLaunch
api.description: Creates a dynent from a model and launches it with the given force.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client to create the dynent for.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: The launch force, given as a direction vector scaled by speed.

parameters.name: fx
parameters.description: A trail effect to play on the launched dynent.

api.example: dynEnt = CreateDynEntAndLaunch(localClientNum, gibModel, pos, angles, self.origin, velocity, gibFx, 1);
remarks: Mostly used for gibbing and destruction, where hitpos is the origin of the entity being broken apart.
The optional fx argument is a trail effect played on the launched piece.

api.name: CreateLUIMenu
api.description: Creates a LUI menu to be opened later with OpenLUIMenu.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Number of the local client on the machine.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the menu to create.

returns.description: The index of the created menu.

remarks: The returned menu index is stored and later passed to OpenLUIMenu and CloseLUIMenu.

api.name: CreateSceneCodeImage
api.description: Creates a scene size code image.

parameters.description: The local client to create the image for.

remarks: Always immediately followed by CaptureFrame with the same image name, and released later with FreeCodeImage.

api.name: CreateSoundRandom
api.description: Creates a randomly repeating sound at the given position.
remarks: Only observed in the shared audio script, driven by script_sound and script_wait_min/max struct fields.

api.name: CreateUIModel
api.description: Creates and returns a UIModel from a parent model.

parameters.name: parentModel
parameters.description: The parent model of the model to retrieve.

parameters.name: newPathName
parameters.description: The name/path of the new model to create.

returns.description: The created UI model.

remarks: The parent is usually GetGlobalUIModel() or GetUIModelForController(localClientNum).
The path may be dotted ("hudItems.sixthsense"), and the returned model is typically passed straight to SetUIModelValue.

api.name: CurrentSessionMode
api.description: Returns the current session mode index.

returns.description: The index of the current session mode.

remarks: Corpus usage passes the result straight into character lookup functions such as GetCharacterFields and GetCharacterModeRenderOptions.

api.name: DebugBreak
api.description: Triggers a debug breakpoint in the script.

api.name: Delete
api.description: Deletes an entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to delete.

api.name: DeleteFX
api.description: Delete a spawned effect.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: client on which to spawn effect.

parameters.name: effectId
parameters.description: The effect id returned by spawnfx.

parameters.name: deleteImmediate
parameters.description: whether effect will be deleted immediately. Default is 1.

remarks: Pairs with PlayFX/SpawnFX, whose returned effect handle is stored on an entity and passed back here.
Callers pass 1 to delete immediately and 0 to let the effect finish.

api.name: DemoIsAnyFreeMoveCamera
api.description: Returns whether any demo camera is currently in free move mode.

returns.description: Whether a demo free move camera is active.

remarks: Always tested together with IsDemoPlaying, to enable rendering that is normally hidden from the first person view.

api.name: DiffTrack
api.description: Returns a lagged value between <from> and <to> based on <rate> and <deltaTime>.

api.name: DiffTrackAngle
api.description: Returns a lagged angle between <from> and <to> based on <rate> and <deltaTime>. Properly accounts for wrapping 2pi.

api.name: DisableDuplicateRendering
api.description: Disables duplicate rendering for the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to disable duplicate rendering on.

remarks: Only observed in the duplicate render manager and bundle scripts, undoing an earlier duplicate render setup.

api.name: DisableOnRadar
api.description: Sets the icon to be shown on the minimap.

api.name: DisableSpeedBlur
api.description: Removes the speed blur effect from the screen.
remarks: Pairs with EnableSpeedBlur, and is called when the ability, killstreak or vision set that turned the blur on ends.

api.name: DisableVehicleSounds
api.description: Disables all sounds from a vehicle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to silence.

remarks: Only observed in the shared vehicle script, silencing a vehicle's sounds.

api.name: Distance
api.description: Returns the Euclidean distance between two points.

returns.name: distance
returns.description: The Euclidean distance between the two points.

remarks: Prefer the use of `DistanceSquared` over `Distance`, because square-root operations are expensive.

api.name: Distance2D
api.description: Returns the 2D Euclidean distance between two points, ignoring the z-axis (height) difference.

returns.name: distance
returns.description: The 2D Euclidean distance between the two points.

remarks: Prefer the use of `Distance2DSquared` over `Distance2D`, because square-root operations are expensive.

api.name: Distance2DSquared
api.description: Returns the squared 2D Euclidean distance between two points, ignoring the z-axis (height) difference.

returns.name: distance
returns.description: The squared 2D Euclidean distance between the two points.

remarks: Prefer the use of `Distance2DSquared` over `Distance2D`, because square-root operations are expensive.

api.name: DistanceSquared
api.description: Returns the squared Euclidean distance between two points.

returns.name: distance
returns.description: The squared Euclidean distance between the two points.

remarks: Prefer the use of `DistanceSquared` over `Distance`, because square-root operations are expensive.

api.name: DragonStrike_Enable
api.description: Enable or disable the DragonStrike effect.

calledOn.name: entity

api.name: GetEntityNumber
api.description: Returns the entity number of the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to get the number of.

returns.description: The entity's number.

remarks: Widely used as a stable per entity key for arrays and UI models, and to compare two entities for identity.
Pairs with GetEntByNum(), which resolves a number back to an entity on a given local client.

api.name: GetEquippedBodyAccentColorForHero
api.description: Returns the equipped body accent color index for the given accent color slot of a specific hero.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The localClientNum of the player in question.

parameters.name: heroIndex
parameters.description: The index of the hero in the current game-mode's character table or in case of lobby client, his queue position.

parameters.name: colorIndex
parameters.description: The accent color slot to read.

parameters.name: getForLobbyClient
parameters.description: If this is set then we are supposed to retrieve for lobby client.

returns.description: The index of the accent color equipped in that slot.

api.example: color = GetEquippedBodyAccentColorForHero( localclientnum, charactermode, characterindex, bodyindex, colorslot );

api.name: GetEquippedBodyForHero
api.description: Returns the name of the equipped body model of a specific hero.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The localClientNum of the player in question.

parameters.name: heroIndex
parameters.description: The index of the hero in the current game-mode's character table.

api.name: GetEquippedBodyIndexForHero
api.description: Returns the index of the equipped body model of a specific hero.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The localClientNum of the player in question.

parameters.name: heroIndex
parameters.description: The index of the hero in the current game-mode's character table or in case of lobby client, his queue position.

parameters.name: getForLobbyClient
parameters.description: If this is set then we are supposed to retrieve for lobby client.

remarks: The lobby client flag is passed as 1 only when reading a lobby client, in which case the hero index is that client's queue index; otherwise it is omitted.

api.name: GetEquippedCharacterIndexForLobbyClientHero
api.description: Returns the equipped character index of the hero belonging to a lobby client.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The localClientNum of the player in question.

parameters.name: lobbyClientQueueIndex
parameters.description: Queue index for lobby client, from which we get all his other information.

returns.description: The character index equipped by that lobby client.

remarks: The observed use caches the result as the characterindex of the lobby client's extra camera hero data.

api.name: GetEquippedHeadIndexForHero
api.description: Returns the index of the equipped head index.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The localClientNum of the player in question.

parameters.name: getForLobbyClient
parameters.description: If this is set then check for the equipped head on the client in the lobbyQueueIndex position.

remarks: A third argument is passed only when reading a lobby client's hero, where it is that client's queue index.

api.name: GetEquippedHelmetAccentColorForHero
api.description: Returns the equipped helmet accent color index for the given accent color slot of a specific hero.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The localClientNum of the player in question.

parameters.name: heroIndex
parameters.description: The index of the hero in the current game-mode's character table.

parameters.name: colorIndex
parameters.description: The accent color slot to read.

parameters.name: getForLobbyClient
parameters.description: If this is set then we are supposed to retrieve for lobby client.

returns.description: The index of the accent color equipped in that slot.

api.example: color = GetEquippedHelmetAccentColorForHero( localclientnum, charactermode, characterindex, helmetindex, colorslot );
remarks: The final lobby client flag is passed as 1 only when reading a lobby client's hero, in which case the hero index is that client's queue index.

api.name: GetEquippedHelmetForHero
api.description: Returns the name of the equipped helmet model of a specific hero.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The localClientNum of the player in question.

parameters.name: heroIndex
parameters.description: The index of the hero in the current game-mode's character table.

api.name: GetEquippedHelmetIndexForHero
api.description: Returns the index of the equipped helmet index of a specific hero.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The localClientNum of the player in question.

parameters.name: heroIndex
parameters.description: The index of the hero in the current game-mode's character table or in case of lobby client, his queue position.

parameters.name: getForLobbyClient
parameters.description: If this is set then we are supposed to retrieve for lobby client.

remarks: The lobby client flag is passed as 1 only when reading a lobby client, in which case the hero index is that client's queue index; otherwise it is omitted.

api.name: GetEquippedHeroIndex
api.description: Returns the index of the equipped hero for the client.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The localClientNum of the player in question.

remarks: The returned index is normally fed to GetHeroGender() or GetCharacterFields() to look the hero up.

api.name: GetEquippedHeroMode
api.description: Returns the mode of the equipped hero for the client.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The localClientNum of the player in question.

remarks: The result is used as the session mode argument to the other GetEquipped* builtins.

api.name: GetEquippedLoadoutItemForHero
api.description: Returns 1 if the hero's ability is equipped, 0 if the weapon is equipped.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The localClientNum of the player in question.

parameters.name: heroIndex
parameters.description: The index of the hero in the current game-mode's character table.

remarks: The observed call compares the result against 1 to decide whether the hero's ability rather than a weapon is equipped.

api.name: GetEquippedShowcaseWeaponForHero
api.description: Returns the showcase weapon of a specific hero.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The localClientNum of the player in question.

parameters.name: heroIndex
parameters.description: The index of the hero in the current game-mode's character table or in case of lobby client, his queue position.

parameters.name: getForLobbyClient
parameters.description: If this is set then we are supposed to retrieve for lobby client.

remarks: The lobby client flag is passed as 1 only when reading a lobby client, in which case the hero index is that client's queue index; otherwise it is omitted.

api.name: GetFirstArrayKey
api.description: Returns the first key of the input array.

api.name: GetFirstHeadOfGender
api.description: Returns the first head of gender ("male" or "female").

returns.description: The index of the first head with the given gender.

api.example: headIndex = GetFirstHeadOfGender( GetHeroGender( characterIndex, sessionMode ), sessionMode );
remarks: Used by character customization to pick a fallback head that matches the gender of the selected hero, typically paired with GetHeroGender.

api.name: GetFirstHeroOfGender
api.description: Returns the first hero of gender ("male" or "female").

returns.description: The index of the first hero with the given gender.

api.example: characterIndex = GetFirstHeroOfGender( GetHeadGender( headIndex, sessionMode ), sessionMode );
remarks: Used by character customization to pick a fallback hero that matches the gender of the selected head, typically paired with GetHeadGender.

api.name: GetFlowGraphDef
api.description: returns a struct representing the flow graph definition asset.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the flow graph asset.

api.name: GetFootstepStrings
api.description: Returns an array containing all the footstep names.

api.name: GetFriendlyScramblerAmount
api.description: Returns the amount alpha of the friendly scrambler applied.

api.name: GetFXFromSurfaceTable
api.description: Returns the fx for a given surface type from the surfacefxtable.

parameters.name: surfacefxtable
parameters.description: The surface fx table to look the effect up in.

parameters.name: surfaceType
parameters.description: The surface type to look up, such as the "surfacetype" field of a trace result.

returns.description: The effect for the given surface type.

remarks: Usually called with the surface type returned by a trace, so that an impact effect matches the material that was hit.

api.name: GetGadgetPower
api.description: Returns the current power level of the player gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: Slot of the gadget. Default is 0.

returns.description: The current power level of the gadget.

remarks: Observed compared against 1 to test whether the gadget is fully charged.

api.name: GetGametypeSetting
api.description: Gets the value of a gametype setting.

parameters.name: setting
parameters.description: The name of the gametype setting to read.

returns.description: The value of the setting.

remarks: Read on both sides of the game, so client scripts commonly cache the value on level during init.
Observed settings include "classicMode", "silentPlant", "playerMaxHealth", "zmDifficulty", "magic" and "headshotsonly".

api.name: GetGlobalUIModel
api.description: Returns the global UI model, the root model that is not tied to a specific local client.
remarks: Typically passed as the parent to CreateUIModel or GetUIModel to create or read a globally scoped model.
Use GetUIModelForController instead when the model should be per local client.

api.name: GetHeadGender
api.description: Returns the given head's gender ("male" or "female").

returns.description: The gender of the head, "male" or "female".

remarks: Used by character customization, commonly feeding its result into GetFirstHeroOfGender.

api.name: GetHealthOverlayTime
api.description: Returns the time the health overlay has been on.

api.name: GetHeliDamageState
api.description: Returns the damage state of the heli.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The helicopter entity.

returns.description: The current damage state of the helicopter.

remarks: Client scripts poll it and compare against the previously stored state to spawn the matching damage effect when it changes.
Observed states include 1 and 2, with higher values corresponding to heavier damage effects.

api.name: GetHelmetAccentColorCountForHero
api.description: Gets the number of helmet accent colors available for a hero item.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client number to resolve unlock and customization data for.

parameters.name: characterType
parameters.description: The character type or hero index.

returns.name: accentColorCount
returns.description: The number of accent colors available for the helmet.

api.example: accentColorCount = GetHelmetAccentColorCountForHero( localClientNum, mode, characterType, itemIndex );

api.name: GetHeroBodyModelIndices
api.description: Returns the given hero's body models for the current session mode.

api.name: GetHeroes
api.description: Returns all hero indices for the current session mode (or specified session mode).

api.name: GetHeroGender
api.description: Returns the given hero's gender ("male" or "female").

returns.description: The gender of the hero, "male" or "female".

remarks: Commonly called on the index returned by GetEquippedHeroIndex to pick gender specific models or animations.

api.name: GetHeroHeadModelIndices
api.description: Returns all hero indices for the current session mode.

api.name: GetHeroHelmetModelIndices
api.description: Returns the given hero's helmet models for the current session mode.

api.name: GetHorizontalOffsetFromScreenCenter
api.description: Returns the horizontal offset of the entity from the center of the screen.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to measure the offset to.

returns.description: The horizontal offset from the screen center.

remarks: Observed driving a HUD element's offset, with the result written into a UI model value.

api.name: GetInKillcam
api.description: Returns whether the client is currently in the killcam.
remarks: Widely used to suppress client side effects, sounds and view changes while a killcam is playing.
Often paired with IsSpectating or IsThirdPerson in the same condition.

api.name: GetItemGroupForWeaponName
api.description: Returns the item group for a specific weapon name.

parameters.name: weaponName
parameters.description: The weapon name to get the item group for.

returns.description: The item group of the weapon.

remarks: Called with a root weapon name, so scripts resolve weapon.rootweapon.name before passing it in.

api.name: GetItemIndexFromRef
api.description: Returns the item index for the specified item reference.

returns.description: The item index for the given item reference.

api.name: GetKillCamEntity
api.description: Returns the entity the killcam is currently following.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

returns.description: The entity the killcam is following.

remarks: Observed guarded by GetInKillcam, so scripts can tell which entity the spectating view is attached to.

api.name: GetKnownLength
api.description: Get the known length of the sound.

api.name: GetLastArrayKey
api.description: Returns the last key of the input array.

api.name: GetLocalClientAngles
api.description: Get the local client angles.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: the client to get angles for.

returns.description: The view angles of the local client.

remarks: Commonly paired with GetLocalClientEyePos to build a view ray for traces or dot product visibility checks.

api.name: GetLocalClientDriver
api.description: Returns the local client index of the driver of the vehicle if the driver is a local client or undefined.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to check for a local driver.

remarks: Used on a vehicle to decide whether the local machine's view is the one driving it.

api.name: GetLocalClientEyePos
api.description: Gets the local client eye pos.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: the client to get eye pos for.

returns.description: The eye position of the local client.

api.example: trace = BulletTrace( GetLocalClientEyePos( localClientNum ), position, 0, self );
remarks: Frequently used as the start point of a trace from the local viewer, or with GetLocalClientAngles to build a view direction.

api.name: GetLocalClientFOV
api.description: Get the local client field of view in degrees.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: the client index to get fov for.

returns.description: The field of view of the local client in degrees.

remarks: Observed scaled and fed into Cos to build a dot product limit for on screen visibility checks.

api.name: GetLocalClientNumber
api.description: Returns the local client number.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to get the local client number of.

returns.description: The local client number of the player, or undefined if the player is not local.

remarks: Returns undefined for players that are not local, so call sites usually guard with IsDefined or IsLocalPlayer.
Commonly compared against the local client number a client callback was passed to filter out other split screen clients.

api.name: GetLocalClientPos
api.description: Returns the position of the local client.

returns.description: The position of the local client.

remarks: Observed in audio scripts to measure distance from the listening client to an emitter.

api.name: GetLocalGunnerAngles
api.description: Returns the angles of the specified gunner, local to the vehicle itself.

parameters.name: gunnerIndex
parameters.description: The index of the gunner seat.

api.name: GetLocalPlayer
api.description: Get the local player predicted centity.

returns.description: The predicted player entity for the given local client.

remarks: The standard way for a client script to reach the player entity for a given local client.
Use GetNonPredictedLocalPlayer when the non predicted entity is needed instead.

api.name: GetLocalPlayers
api.description: Get an array of all the local players.

returns.description: An array of the local player entities.

remarks: Scripts commonly index element 0 for the primary local player, or loop the array to cover split screen clients.
The array can be empty early in a level, so scripts sometimes wait until its size is non zero.

api.name: GetLocalPlayerTeam
api.description: Gets the team of the local player.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Number of the local client to check.

remarks: Typically compared against another entity's team to decide whether client side effects or dialog are friendly or enemy.

api.name: GetLUIMenu
api.description: Gets the first instance found of a given menu name active for the given client (undefined if not found).

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Number of the local client on the machine.

returns.description: The menu instance, or undefined if no such menu is active.

remarks: Returns undefined when the menu is not open, so call sites guard with IsDefined before using the result.

api.name: GetLUIMenuData
api.description: Gets data from a LUI menu.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Number of the local client on the machine.

parameters.name: menuDataName
parameters.description: Menu Data Name linked to the UIModel.

api.name: GetMapAtIndex
api.description: Get the name of the map at the given index in a mode's maptable.  Returns undefined if the given index doesn't index the given maptable.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: the index of the map you're looking for.

parameters.name: dlcindex
parameters.description: dlc1..N if DLC.  If ommitted, use "base".

parameters.name: sessionmodeabbrev
parameters.description: cp,mp,zm.  If ommitted, use current game mode abbreviation.

api.name: GetMapCenter
api.description: Returns the map center.

returns.description: The center position of the map.

api.name: GetMapFields
api.description: Get the outro movie of the current map in the maptable.  Returns undefined if currentmap wasn't found.

parameters.name: currentmap
parameters.description: the name of the current map.  If ommitted, use Dvar sv_mapname.

parameters.name: dlcindex
parameters.description: dlc1..N if DLC.  If ommitted, use "base".

parameters.name: sessionmodeabbrev
parameters.description: cp,mp,zm.  If ommitted, use current game mode abbreviation.

api.name: GetMaxLocalClients
api.description: Get the max number of local clients.

returns.description: The maximum number of local clients.

remarks: Usually used as the loop bound when a client script has to run over every split screen client.

api.name: GetMaxReverseSpeed
api.description: Get maximum reverse speed of a vehicle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to get the maximum reverse speed of.

returns.description: The maximum reverse speed of the vehicle.

remarks: Paired with GetMaxSpeed, picking the reverse value when the vehicle's speed is negative.

api.name: GetMaxSpeed
api.description: Gets the vehicle's maximum speed in inches per second.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to get the maximum speed of.

returns.name: maxSpeed
returns.description: The maximum speed of the vehicle in inches per second.

api.example: vr = Abs( self GetSpeed() / self GetMaxSpeed() );

api.name: GetMigrationStatus
remarks: Used as an early out at the top of client callbacks, so work is skipped for the local client while the value is truthy.

api.name: GetMinBitCountForNum
api.description: Returns the minimum number of bits needed to express the provided integer.

parameters.name: uint
parameters.description: The integer a minimum bit count is needed for.

returns.description: The minimum number of bits needed to express the value.

remarks: Almost always used to size the bit count argument of clientfield::register.
Scripts commonly pass the highest value that has to be encoded, such as an array size minus one.

api.name: GetMovementType
api.description: Returns the movement type for the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to get the movement type of.

returns.description: The movement type of the entity, such as "sprint".

remarks: Observed compared against "sprint" to gate movement driven sounds.

api.name: GetMpDialogName
api.description: Gets the multiplayer dialog name for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to get the dialog name of.

returns.description: The multiplayer dialog name of the player.

remarks: Used as a lookup key into per character dialog tables and as the bundle name for multiplayer announcer lines.

api.name: GetNextArrayKey
api.description: Returns the next key of the input array, after the specified key.

api.name: GetNonPredictedLocalPlayer
api.description: Get the local player non predicted centity.

returns.description: The non predicted player entity for the given local client.

remarks: Can be undefined early on, so scripts often wait until it is defined before using it.
Use GetLocalPlayer when the predicted entity is wanted instead.

api.name: GetNotetracksInDelta
api.description: Get notetracks within a time delta of an animation.

returns.description: An array of the notetracks found within the time delta.

api.name: GetNumFreeEntities
api.description: Get the number of free fake entities.

parameters.name: localClientNumber
parameters.description: Which local client to spawn the entity for.

returns.description: The number of free client entities.

remarks: Used during demo playback to skip spawning cosmetic client entities when the entity budget is nearly exhausted.

api.name: GetOwner
api.description: Get an entity's owner.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to get the owner of.

returns.description: The owner of the entity.

remarks: Commonly called on a deployed gadget, sensor or projectile to find the player that placed or fired it.
The result is often compared against the local players to decide whether owner only effects should be shown.

api.name: GetParentEntity
api.description: Returns the entity this entity is linked to on the client, or undefined if it is not linked.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to read the parent of.

returns.description: The parent entity, or undefined if there is none.

remarks: Used by projectile scripts such as sticky grenades and explosive bolts to find the surface or entity the projectile stuck to.
The result is usually checked with IsDefined before use.

api.name: GetPlaybackTime
api.description: Get the playback time for the sound given by playbackId.

api.name: GetPlayerCorpse
api.description: Returns the most recent corpse entity for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose corpse is retrieved.

returns.description: The player's most recent corpse entity.

remarks: Used by client face animation code to keep facial animation running on a player's corpse after death.

api.name: GetPlayerGibDef
api.description: Returns the name of the gib definition for the player, or "unknown" if none is set.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to read the gib definition from.

returns.description: The gib definition name, or "unknown" when none is set.

remarks: The gib system treats a result of "unknown" as meaning the entity has no gib definition.

api.name: GetPlayerLastOutWaterTime
api.description: Gets the last time the player was not underwater.

api.name: GetPlayerName
api.description: Gets the character index.

api.name: GetPlayers
api.description: Returns an array of the currently connected players.

returns.name: players
returns.description: A list of connected players.

api.name: GetPlayerVehicle
api.description: Returns the vehicle the given player is riding, or undefined if the player is not in a vehicle.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to get the vehicle of.

returns.description: The vehicle entity, or undefined if the player is not in a vehicle.

remarks: The player is commonly obtained from GetLocalPlayer, and the result is checked with IsDefined before use.

api.name: GetPrevArrayKey
api.description: Returns the prev key of the input array, before the specified key.

api.name: GetPrimaryDeltaAnim
api.description: Returns the primary delta animation playing on this entity, or the animation name if the entity is in an animscripted state.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to read the animation from.

returns.description: The name of the primary delta animation.

remarks: Used by secondary animation code to decide which additive animations to layer on an AI.

api.name: GetRealTime
api.description: Returns the real system time in milliseconds.

returns.description: The real time in milliseconds.

remarks: Commonly captured once and subtracted from a later call, dividing by 1000 to get elapsed seconds.
Unlike GetServerTime it takes no local client number, so it is used for timing that must run regardless of server time.

api.name: GetRevealPulseMaxRadius
api.description: Returns the max radius for the reveal vision pulse.

api.name: GetRevealPulseOrigin
api.description: Returns the origin of the local client's reveal pulse.

returns.description: The world origin of the reveal pulse.

remarks: Used by the vision pulse gadget alongside GetVisionPulseRadius and GetVisionPulseMaxRadius.

api.name: GetRevealPulseRadius
api.description: Returns the radius for the local client reveal pulse.

api.name: GetRope
api.description: Returns the rope index based on targetname. Use it for ropes setuped in radiant. Returns -1, if not found.

parameters.name: targetname
parameters.description: The targetname of the rope you interested in.

api.name: GetScriptBundle
api.description: Returns the script bundle struct.

api.name: GetScriptBundleList
api.description: Returns the script bundle list array.

api.name: GetScriptBundleNames
api.description: Returns all the names of the script bundles of the specified type in an array.

api.name: GetScriptBundles
api.description: Returns a list of script bundles based on the type.

api.name: GetServerHighestClientFieldVersion
api.description: Returns the highest client field version supported by the server.

returns.description: The server's highest client field version.

remarks: Used to gate script behavior on the server's protocol version, either by comparing against a version constant or by caching the value for later checks.

api.name: GetServerTime
api.description: Returns the current server time in milliseconds for the given local client.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client to read the server time for.

parameters.name: includeFrameTime
parameters.description: Whether to include the current frame's time.

returns.description: The server time in milliseconds.

remarks: Widely used to stamp a start time and compare against it later; divide by 1000 for seconds.
Call sites pass a local client number, often just 0, and rarely pass the optional second argument.

api.name: GetServerVolumetricFogDensity
api.description: Get the density of server volumetric fog.

api.name: GetShoutcasterSetting
api.description: Returns the value of the named shoutcaster setting for the local client.

parameters.name: setting
parameters.description: The name of the shoutcaster setting to read.

remarks: Setting names observed in the corpus are prefixed with "shoutcaster_", such as "shoutcaster_team_identity" and "shoutcaster_fe_team1_color".
Usually combined with a check that the local client is actually a shoutcaster.

api.name: GetSoundFromSurfaceTable
api.description: Returns the fx for a given surface type from the surfacefxtable.

api.name: GetSpawnStructForCharacter
api.description: Returns the targetname of the script_struct to use for the character pose in the frontend.

parameters.name: characterIndex
parameters.description: The index of the character in the current game-mode's character table.

api.name: GetSpeed
api.description: Gets the vehicle's current speed in inches per second.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The vehicle to get the speed of.

returns.name: speed
returns.description: The vehicle's speed in inches per second.

api.example: vr = Abs( self GetSpeed() / self GetMaxSpeed() );

api.name: GetSteering
api.description: Returns the steer factor of the vehicle.

api.name: GetStreamerRequestProgress
api.description: Returns the progress, from 0 to 100, of the given streamer request slot.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The streamer request slot to query.

returns.description: The progress of the request, from 0 to 100.

remarks: Compared against 100 to decide when streamed assets for a scene have finished loading.

api.name: GetStreamingProgress
api.description: Gets a progress value between 0 (no progress) and 1 (complete) for all the models and meshes that the script is currently forcing.

api.name: GetStructField
api.description: Returns the value of a named field on a script bundle struct.

parameters.name: struct
parameters.description: The struct or bundle to read from.

parameters.name: fieldName
parameters.description: The name of the field to read.

remarks: Almost always used to read numbered fields from asset bundles, with the field name built by concatenating a prefix, an index, and a suffix.
Reading a field that does not exist yields an undefined value, which callers test before use.

api.name: GetSubStr
api.description: Returns the substring of the given string starting at the start index and ending before the optional end index.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: The string to take a substring of.

parameters.name: startIndex
parameters.description: The index of the first character to include.

parameters.name: endIndex
parameters.description: The index just past the last character to include; the rest of the string is used if omitted.

returns.description: The requested substring.

remarks: Commonly used to strip a known prefix or suffix from a client field name, using the .size of the string to compute the end index.

api.name: GetSurfaceStrings
api.description: Returns an array of all surface type names.

returns.description: An array of surface names.

remarks: Used by footstep code to build a lookup of per-surface data at init time.

api.name: GetSystemTime
api.description: Returns the current system time as a vector where index 0 is the hour in 24 hour form, index 1 is the minute, and index 2 is the second.

returns.description: A vector of hours, minutes, and seconds.

remarks: Ambient systems call it with no argument for local time and with 1 to ignore the timezone.
Typically sampled repeatedly and compared against a previously stored value to detect the passage of time.

api.name: GetTagAngles
api.description: Gets the angles of the given tag on an entity.

api.name: GetTopPlayersHelmetModel

parameters.name: topPlayerIndex
parameters.description: The index of the top player.

returns.description: The helmet model name.

remarks: Called next to GetTopPlayersBodyModel when building end of game podium characters.

api.name: GetTopPlayersHelmetRenderOptions
api.description: Returns the render options for the helmet of the top player at the given index.

parameters.name: topPlayerIndex
parameters.description: The index of the top player.

returns.description: The helmet render options.

remarks: Called next to GetTopPlayersHelmetModel when setting up end of game podium characters.

api.name: GetTopPlayersWeaponInfo
api.description: Returns information about the equipped weapon of the top player at the given index.

parameters.name: topPlayerIndex
parameters.description: The index of the top player.

remarks: Used by the end of game flow to give podium characters the weapon their player was holding.

parameters.name: topPlayerIndex

parameters.name: topPlayerIndex
parameters.description: The index of the top player.

returns.description: The weapon render options.

remarks: Called next to GetTopPlayersWeaponInfo when setting up end of game podium characters.

api.name: GetTopScorerCount
api.description: Returns the number of clients in the top scorers array.

returns.description: The number of top scorers.

remarks: Used as the loop bound when iterating top players with the GetTopPlayers* builtins.

api.name: GetTotalAmmo
api.description: Returns the total amount of ammo the client has for the currently equipped weapon.

parameters.name: weaponName
parameters.description: Name of the desired weapon to check.

api.name: GetUIModel

parameters.name: lookupModelName

api.name: GetUIModelForController
api.description: Returns the root UI model for the given local client's controller.

returns.description: The controller's root UI model.

remarks: Almost always passed straight into GetUIModel or CreateUIModel as the parent for a per-player UI model.

api.name: GetUIModelValue
api.description: Returns the current value stored in the given UI model.

returns.description: The model's current value.

remarks: The model usually comes from GetUIModel or CreateUIModel.
Pairs with SetUIModelValue, which writes the value back.

api.name: GetVelocity
api.description: Returns the entity's current velocity as a vector.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to read the velocity of.

returns.description: The entity's velocity vector.

remarks: Used on players, vehicles, and AI; passing the result to Length gives the entity's speed.

api.name: GetVisionPulseMaxRadius
api.description: Returns the maximum radius of the local client's vision pulse.

returns.description: The maximum vision pulse radius.

remarks: Used by the vision pulse gadget together with GetVisionPulseRadius to work out how far the pulse has expanded.

api.name: GetVisionPulseRadius
api.description: Returns the current radius of the local client's vision pulse.

returns.description: The current vision pulse radius.

remarks: Read each frame next to GetVisionPulseMaxRadius while the vision pulse gadget is active.

api.name: GetVisionSetNaked
api.description: Returns the name of the local client's current naked vision set.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client whose naked vision set is read.

returns.description: The name of the current naked vision set.

remarks: Typically saved off before a script applies a temporary vision set, so the original can be restored afterwards.
Common in teleporter and gadget scripts that override vision for the duration of an effect.

api.name: GetVRCamAnglesByLocalClientNum

api.name: GetVRCamPosByLocalClientNum
api.description: Get the camera position of the local client given.
