api.name: GetVRControllerGripButton
api.description: returns true if the grip button is pressed.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Client number of the controller you want.

parameters.name: handIdx
parameters.description: 0 for dominant hand, 1 for secondary hand. Secondary hand is not guaranteed to exist.

api.name: GetVRControllerPosition
api.description: gets the world-space position of the tracked VR controller.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Client number of the controller you want the position of.

parameters.name: handIdx
parameters.description: 0 for dominant hand, 1 for secondary hand. Secondary hand is not guaranteed to exist.

api.name: GetVRControllerXButton
api.description: returns true if the grip button is pressed.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Client number of the controller you want.

parameters.name: handIdx
parameters.description: 0 for dominant hand, 1 for secondary hand. Secondary hand is not guaranteed to exist.

api.name: GetWeapon
api.description: Returns the weapon object for the given weapon name and optional attachments.

returns.description: The weapon object for the given name.

remarks: Usually called with just a weapon name and the result cached on level or a struct.
GetWeapon( "none" ) yields the null weapon that scripts compare against.

api.name: GetWeaponAmmoClip
api.description: Gets the amount of ammo in the given weapon's magazine (clip).

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to check the amount of magazine ammo on.

returns.name: ammo
returns.description: The amount of ammo in the magazine.

api.name: GetWeaponChargeLevel
api.description: Get the current charge level for charged shot weapons.
remarks: Used by charge-based weapons such as the beast mode and staff weapons, typically polled and compared against a stored charge value to detect changes.

api.name: GetWeaponForCharacter
api.description: Returns the weapon at the given index.

parameters.name: characterIndex
parameters.description: The index of the character in the current game-mode's character table.

returns.description: The weapon assigned to that character.

remarks: Seen in the frontend when building the character showcase, where the resulting weapon is stored on a params struct.

api.name: GetWeaponHackRatio
api.description: Get the players hack completion ratio.

returns.description: The hack completion ratio for the local client.

remarks: Called from the hacker tool script to drive the hack progress readout.

api.name: GetWeaponModelForCharacter
api.description: Returns the name of the weapon model of at the given index.

parameters.name: characterIndex
parameters.description: The index of the character in the current game-mode's character table.

api.name: GetWeaponPosFrac
api.description: Gets the weapon pos frac of the player. It only works for the player.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Player to get weapon pos frac for.

api.name: GetWeaponWithAttachments
api.description: Returns the weapon object for a base weapon name that includes attachments.

parameters.name: weaponname
parameters.description: the name of the base weapon with attachments to return.

returns.description: The weapon object built from the given name and attachments.

remarks: Used by character and weapon customization scripts, where the full weapon string (base weapon plus attachments) is built up before the lookup.

api.name: GetWeaponXCam
api.description: Gets the XCam for a weapon.

returns.description: The name of the XCam to use for the weapon.

remarks: Used by weapon customization and custom class screens to pick the camera used to display a weapon.

api.name: GetWorldFogScriptID
api.description: current active .fsi fog volumes script identity value -1 = global volume.

returns.description: The script identity of the active fog volume, or -1 for the global volume.

remarks: Seen in the visionset manager, where the returned identifier selects which fog volume settings to apply.

api.name: GetXCamForCharacter
api.description: Returns the name of the xcam to use for the character pose in the frontend.

parameters.name: characterIndex
parameters.description: The index of the character in the current game-mode's character table.

api.name: GetXCamMouseControl
api.description: Get the current "yaw" and "pitch" of the mouse xcam.  Returns an array with two keys, "yaw" and "pitch".

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Client number of the controller you want the mouse yaw/pitch of.

remarks: Seen in character customization, where the returned yaw and pitch drive the showcase camera.

api.name: GetXModelCenterOffset
api.description: Calculates the offset to the center of the model from the origin.

api.name: HasAnimTree
api.description: Returns true if the entity has an anim tree.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to check.

returns.name: hasAnimTree
returns.description: Whether the entity has an anim tree.

api.name: HasDObj
api.description: Returns 1 if the entity currently has a dobj.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to test.

parameters.name: localClientNumber
parameters.description: number of the local client on the machine.

returns.description: Whether the entity currently has a dobj.

remarks: Commonly guards code that touches tags, models or animations on an entity, since those are only valid once the entity has a dobj.
Often used in a wait loop that spins until the dobj exists, and paired with IsDefined checks on the entity.

api.name: HasPerk
api.description: Gets whether the given player has a particular perk.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

parameters.name: specialtyName
parameters.description: The specialty name of the perk.

returns.name: hasPerk
returns.description: Whether they have the specified perk.

api.name: Hide
api.description: Hides the given entity.

calledOn.name: target
calledOn.description: The entity to hide.

api.name: HidePart
api.description: Hide part of an entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose part is hidden.

remarks: Used to hide individual tags on a model, for example unlit portals, gumballs or weapon tags.
The optional model name is passed as an empty string when only the children flag is needed.

api.name: HideStaticModel
api.description: Hide a static model.

parameters.name: smodelIndex
parameters.description: The index of the static model to toggle.

remarks: Takes the index returned by a static model lookup, and is commonly called over an array of indices to hide a group of map models.

api.name: HideVolumeDecal
api.description: Hides a volume decal.

parameters.name: volumeDecalIndex
parameters.description: The index of the volume decal to toggle.

remarks: Used to hide map volume decals by index, for example when toggling hallucination decals on and off.

api.name: IGCActive
api.description: Flags if an IGC is on or off.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Local client on which the igc is running.

remarks: Called from the shared scene system when an in-game cinematic starts or stops.

api.name: InitClientObjectives
api.description: Delete a spawned effect.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: client on which to clear the objectives.

api.name: Int
api.description: Casts a floating point number or a string to an integer.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: A string or floating point number to cast to an integer.

remarks: Widely used to convert level script strings such as script_noteworthy or script_parameters into numbers, and to truncate the result of arithmetic or math builtins.

api.name: IPrintLnBold
api.description: Prints a line of text to the bottom left corner of the screen.

parameters.name: extraParameters
parameters.description: If the message is a localized string, this can be used to pass numbered parameters into the interpolated string.

api.name: PrintLn
api.description: Writes a line to the console.

parameters.name: extraParameters
parameters.description: Zero or more additional strings to append to the log message.

api.name: IsADS
api.description: Returns true if this local client is in ADS, false otherwise.
remarks: Seen combined with other local player state checks such as IsThrowingGrenade, IsMeleeing and IsOnTurret.

api.name: IsAi
api.description: Gets whether the given entity is an AI.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to check.

returns.name: isAi
returns.description: Whether the entity is an AI.

api.name: IsAlive
api.description: Gets whether the given entity is alive.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to check whether it is alive.

returns.name: isAlive
returns.description: Whether the entity is alive.

api.name: IsAnimLooping
api.description: Gets whether an animation is looped or not.

returns.description: Whether the animation loops.

remarks: Mostly used in asserts to catch looping animations being used where a one-shot animation is required, such as death or face animations.

api.name: IsArchetypeLoaded
api.description: Returns whether an archetype is loaded.

returns.description: Whether the archetype is loaded.

remarks: Seen in shared AI setup as a guard before running archetype specific client logic.

api.name: IsArray
api.description: Returns true if the given value is an array.

returns.description: Whether the value is an array.

remarks: Very commonly used as a guard before iterating or reading size, often alongside IsDefined on the same value.

api.name: IsAttached
api.description: Returns true if the model is attached to the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity the model may be attached to.

parameters.name: modelname
parameters.description: The name of the model to test if attached.

returns.description: Whether the model is attached.

remarks: Used before attaching or detaching a model to avoid duplicate attachments, particularly in character customization.
The tag argument is passed as an empty string when any tag will do.

api.name: IsCameraSpikeToggled
api.description: Returns 1 if the camera spike is toggled to be active, 0 otherwise.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Client number of the camera spike owner.

api.name: IsClass
api.description: Checks whether this entity/variable is a class object.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: variable that may or may not be a class.

api.name: IsContentScreenFilterPlaying
api.description: Returns whether or not this player is playing a Graphics Content blocking filter at this moment or not.

api.name: IsCybercomIndexEnabled
api.description: Checks whether a cybercom ability at the given index is enabled for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

returns.name: enabled
returns.description: Whether the cybercom ability is enabled.

remarks: Seen in the cybercom HUD script to decide whether an ability slot should be shown as available.

api.name: IsDemoPlaying
api.description: Returns true if a demo is currently playing back.
remarks: Used to branch client logic during theater playback, often cached into level.isdemoplaying.
Frequently combined with demo helpers such as DemoIsAnyFreeMoveCamera and GetDemoVersion.

api.name: IsDriving
api.description: Returns true if the player is driving a vehicle.
remarks: Seen in shared player utility code alongside other local player state checks.

api.name: IsDynEntValid
api.description: Returns if the dynEnt still valid or not.
remarks: Always paired with an IsDefined check on the dynent, including in wait loops that run while the dynent stays valid.

api.name: IsEntityLinkedToTag
api.description: Returns is the entity is linked to the parententity, ( on a specific tag optional ).

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity that we are checking.

remarks: Used by sticky weapon scripts to find which body tag a stuck projectile is attached to, testing several tags in turn.
The tag argument can be omitted to test whether the entity is linked at all.

api.name: IsEmpJammed
api.description: Gets whether the local player is EMP jammed.

calledOn.name: localPlayer
calledOn.description: The local player to check.

returns.name: isEmpJammed
returns.description: Whether the local player is EMP jammed.

api.name: IsFloat
api.description: Returns true if the given value is a float.

returns.description: Whether the value is a float.

remarks: Seen alongside IsInt and IsString when deciding how to format a value for display.

api.name: IsFriendly
api.description: Returns true if entity is friendly.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to test.

parameters.name: localclientnum
parameters.description: Local client number of the local client you want to test against.

parameters.name: predicted
parameters.description: Test against predicted version, false by default.

returns.description: Whether the entity is friendly to the given local client.

remarks: Used to pick friendly or enemy visuals such as outlines, icons and effect colors.
The optional predicted argument is passed as 1 in perk scripts that run before the server value arrives.

api.name: IsFunctionPtr
api.description: Checks whether given variable is of type Function Pointer in script, useful to differentiate between Var and FuncPtr in Script.
remarks: Used to validate stored callbacks before calling them, often inside an assert.

api.name: IsFXPlaying
api.description: Return true if effect is still playing.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client the effect is playing on.

parameters.name: effectId
parameters.description: The effect id returned by playFx.

remarks: Takes the effect id returned by PlayFX, and is typically used in a wait loop that runs while a looping effect is alive.

api.name: IsGrenadeDud
api.description: Returns if a grenade is a dud.

calledOn.name: grenade
calledOn.description: The grenade or projectile to test.

returns.description: Whether the grenade is a dud.

remarks: Called on a thrown projectile at spawn time by sticky grenades, satchel charges, proximity grenades and explosive bolts, to skip normal effects for duds.

api.name: IsIGCActive
api.description: Returns whether an in-game cinematic is currently active on the given local client.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Local client to find the status of.

returns.description: Whether an in-game cinematic is active.

remarks: Almost always used negated, to suppress HUD, sounds or menus while a cinematic is playing.
Paired with IGCActive, which sets the state from the scene system.

api.name: IsInArray
api.description: Searches an array to determine whether a given value is present in it.
remarks: Commonly used to avoid adding duplicates to an array, and to test membership of weapon or key lists.

api.name: IsInHelicopter
api.description: Returns true if the client is in a helicopter.

api.name: IsInScrCam
api.description: Check if the camera of local client is in scripted camera.

api.name: IsInScritpedAnim
api.description: Returns 1 if the entity currently has scripted animation playing.
remarks: Seen in the client face animation system as a guard before driving facial animation.

api.name: IsInt
api.description: Returns true if the given value is an int.

returns.description: Whether the value is an int.

remarks: Used to distinguish integer array keys or ids from strings, often alongside IsFloat and IsString.

api.name: IsLocalClientDead
api.description: Checks if the local client's pm_type > PM_DEAD.

returns.name: isDead
returns.description: Whether the local client is dead.

api.name: IsLocalClientDriver
api.description: Returns whether the given local client is the driver of this vehicle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to test.

returns.description: Whether the given local client is driving this vehicle.

remarks: Used by vehicle and killstreak scripts to decide whether to run first person driver logic such as HUD, audio and driving effects.
Often negated to drive outline or spectator behavior for non drivers.

api.name: IsLocalPlayer
api.description: Returns true if the ent it's called on is a local player.
remarks: Used as an early out in client callbacks so that logic only runs for players on this machine.
Frequently combined with GetLocalClientNumber or GetEntityNumber to identify which local client the entity is.

api.name: IsLocalPlayerViewLinked
api.description: Returns whether or not this entity is linked to the given local client.

api.name: IsLocalPlayerWeaponViewOnlyLinked
api.description: Returns whether or not this player is linked to an enity with weapon view only linking.
remarks: Seen in shared player utility code alongside IsDriving when deciding how the view weapon is handled.

api.name: IsLuiEnabled
api.description: true if lui system has the input focus.

api.name: IsMatureContentEnabled
api.description: Returns true if mature content is enabled.

returns.description: True if mature content is enabled for this client.

remarks: Scripts pair this with IsShowGibsEnabled to decide whether gore effects may be played.

api.name: IsMeleeing
api.description: Gets whether the player is currently meleeing.

returns.name: isMeleeing
returns.description: Whether the player is currently meleeing.

api.name: IsOnTurret
api.description: Gets whether the player is currently on a turret.

returns.name: onTurret
returns.description: Whether the player is currently on a turret.

api.name: IsPc
api.description: Gets whether the game platform is on PC.

returns.name: isPc
returns.description: Whether the game is being played on PC.

api.example:
// Always true, because we're modders
inPc = IsPc();

api.name: IsPeelingOut
api.description: Returns true if the vehicle is currently peeling out.

api.name: IsPlayer
api.description: Gets whether the given entity is a player.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to check.

returns.name: isPlayer
returns.description: Whether the entity is a player.

api.name: IsPlayerCorpse
api.description: Returns true if the entity it is called on is a player corpse.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to test.

returns.description: True if the entity is a player corpse.

remarks: The gib system checks this alongside IsPlayer so that player bodies and their corpses are treated the same way.

api.name: IsPlayerDead
api.description: Returns 1 if the entity currently has health of 0 or less.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is dead.

api.name: IsPlayerDoubleJumping
api.description: Returns 1 if the player is currently double jumping (boosting).

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is double jumping.

api.name: IsPlayerFiring
api.description: Returns 1 if the player is currently firing.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is firing.

remarks: Used by the client face animation system to pick a facial state from the player's current movement or firing state.

api.name: IsPlayerJumping
api.description: Returns 1 if the player is currently jumping.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is jumping.

api.name: IsPlayerSliding
api.description: Returns 1 if the player is currently sliding.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is sliding.

api.name: IsPlayerSprinting
api.description: Returns 1 if the player is currently sprinting.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is sprinting.

api.name: IsPlayerSwimming
api.description: Returns true if the player it is called on is swimming.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: Non-zero if the player is swimming.

api.name: IsPlayerSwimmingOnSurface
api.description: Return if a player is swimming.

api.name: IsPlayerSwimmingUnderwater
api.description: Return if a player is swimming.

api.name: IsPlayerTalking
api.description: Returns 1 if the player is talking.

api.name: IsPlayerWallRunning
api.description: Returns 1 if the player is currently wall running.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is wall running.

remarks: Typically checked before IsPlayerWallRunningRight to work out which side the player is running on.

api.name: IsPlayerWallRunningRight
api.description: Returns 1 if the player is currently wall running right.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is wall running on their right.

remarks: Checked after IsPlayerWallRunning to determine the side of the wall run.

api.name: IsPlayingLoopSound
api.description: Returns true if the entity is playing a loop sound.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity that may be playing the loop sound.

returns.description: True if the entity is playing a loop sound.

remarks: The helicopter sound scripts call it with no alias, to check whether a surface loop is already playing on an entity before starting another.

api.name: IsProfileBuild
api.description: Checks whether the current build is a profile build.

returns.name: isProfileBuild
returns.description: Whether this is a profile build.

api.name: IsRobot
api.description: Returns true if the ent it's called on is a sentient vehicle i.e. a Robot.

api.name: IsScrambled
api.description: Returns the if player is getting scrambled by an enemy.

api.name: IsShoutcaster
api.description: Returns 1 if the local client is shoutcasting.

parameters.name: checkFistPerson
parameters.description: Check if we want first person spectating to be not considered as spectate.

returns.description: True if that local client is shoutcasting.

api.name: IsShowBloodEnabled
api.description: Returns true if blood is enabled.

remarks: Filters are set up by calling SetFilterPassMaterial and then enabling the pass, and torn down by calling this again with 0.
Most call sites pass only the first four arguments and leave the HDR and first person flags default.

api.name: SetFilterPassMaterial
api.description: Sets the material used by a filter pass.

parameters.name: materialIndex
parameters.description: Index of the material, usually looked up by name with filter::mapped_material_id.

remarks: The material index is looked up by name first, either through filter::mapped_material_id or through the level's filter material id table.
Normally followed by SetFilterPassEnabled to turn the pass on.

api.name: SetFilterPassQuads
api.description: Sets the number of quads a filter pass draws.
remarks: The corpus only uses a few values, most often 400 or the maximum 2048, and 0 when tearing the pass down.

api.name: SetFlagAsAway
api.description: Sets a capture the flag team flag as away from or back at its home base.
remarks: Only used by capture the flag, which sets the flag home again when it is returned.

api.name: SetFlaggedAnimKnob
api.description: Plays an animation on the entity through a named animation knob, with a weight and blend times.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to play the animation on.

parameters.name: knobName
parameters.description: The name of the animation knob to play through.

remarks: Every observed call uses the "ai_secondary_facial_anim" knob to drive an AI facial animation.

api.name: SetForceNotSimple
api.description: Sets the forceNotSimple flag on the entity so it is not rendered as a simple entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to flag.

remarks: The only call site applies it to the deployed riot shield model.

api.name: SetFriendlyNameDraw
api.description: Turns local client friendly name drawing on or off.

parameters.name: onOff
parameters.description: True if friendly name drawing is turned on.

api.name: SetFriendlyScramblerAmount
api.description: Sets the alpha amount of the friendly scrambler effect applied to the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to apply the scrambler amount to.

remarks: The scrambler script updates this amount for friendly players and uses SetEnemyGlobalScrambler for enemies.

api.name: SetFXIgnorePause
api.description: Sets whether an effect ignores a paused world state.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client the effect is playing on.

parameters.name: effectId
parameters.description: The effect id returned by playFx.

parameters.name: ignorePause
parameters.description: Whether or not to respect a paused world state.

remarks: Called right after the effect is created, with the handle returned by the play effect call.
Every observed call passes 1, so the effect keeps playing while the world is paused.

api.name: SetFXOutdoor
api.description: Flags an effect as one that only plays outdoors.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client the effect is playing on.

parameters.name: effectId
parameters.description: The effect id returned by playFx.

remarks: Applied to weather style level effects just after they are created.

api.name: SetFXTeam
api.description: Sets the team an effect belongs to, either by team name or by an entity that has a team.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Local client on which to play the fx.

parameters.name: effectHandle
parameters.description: The handle from the created fx.

parameters.name: entityOrTeam
parameters.description: The team name, or an entity that has a team set.

parameters.name: invertTeam
parameters.description: Treat the team as the one to show the enemy fx for.

remarks: Objective scripts use it so base, flag and goal effects are tinted per team.
Usually called with the handle returned by the play effect call, either a team string or an entity's team field.

api.name: SetGenericSceneValue
api.description: Sets one of the 16 generic scene vectors used by SW shaders.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Some generic float used by SW shaders.

api.name: SetGlobalFutz
api.description: Sets the global futz.

api.name: SetGroupSnapshot
api.description: Sets the active audio group snapshot by name.
remarks: The shared audio script sets the active snapshot and later the next one as it blends between them.

api.name: SetHealthSnapshot
api.description: Sets the health snapshot.

api.name: SetHideWhenScriptedAnimationCompleted
api.description: When playing a scene this will hide the entity when the scripted animation ends on it.

api.name: SetHighDetail
api.description: Sets whether the given model entity should be rendered with high detail and/or in alternative rendering mode.

calledOn.name: model
calledOn.description: The model entity.

parameters.name: useHighDetail
parameters.description: Whether the model should be rendered in high detail.

parameters.name: useAltRenderMode
parameters.description: Whether the alternative rendering mode should be used.

api.name: SetHotZone
api.description: Sets HotZone control values.

api.name: SetInfraredVisionSet
api.description: Sets the vision set used by the entity when infrared vision is active.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to set the infrared vision set on.

remarks: Applied to each player from the client connect callbacks, using the vision set name stored on level.

api.name: SetInTacticalHud
api.description: Sets if the player has the tactical hud open.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

remarks: Scripts pass 1 when the cybercom tactical menu opens and 0 when it closes.

api.name: SetLevelFadeSnapshot
api.description: Sets the level fade snapshot.

api.name: SetLitFogBank
api.description: Sets which bank to use for all lit fog volumes with matching script id.

parameters.name: scriptid
parameters.description: Volume identifier set in Radiant. (0-255). -1 = all.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time in seconds to make the transition over. -1 to use the 'fogtime' parameter set in the volume.

remarks: Almost every call site passes -1 for the script id to affect all lit fog volumes, and -1 for the time so the volume's own fogtime is used.
Commonly called next to SetWorldFogActiveBank when a script swaps the level's fog look.

api.name: SetLocalRadarEnabled
api.description: Sets whether a client's local radar is enabled.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Client number to set local radar on.

remarks: Used by the acoustic sensor script, which disables the radar on player connect and re-enables it per local client while a sensor is active.

api.name: SetLocalRadarPosition
api.description: Sets the position of a client's local radar.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Client number to set local radar position on.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: New position of the local radar.

remarks: The observed use centers the local radar on the origin of an active acoustic sensor entity, and is paired with SetLocalRadarEnabled.

api.name: SetLoopState
api.description: set pitch and volume per entity/alias.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity emitting the loop sound.

remarks: Called on the entity playing the looping alias, usually inside a per-frame update that maps vehicle speed or angle onto volume and pitch.
The optional rate arguments are passed together to smooth the transition, for example 1 and 0.15 on helicopter loops.

api.name: SetLUIMenuData
api.description: Set data for LUI menu.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Number of the local client on the machine.

parameters.name: menuDataName
parameters.description: Menu Data Name linked to the UIModel.

parameters.name: menuDataValue
parameters.description: Value for that piece of menu data.

remarks: The menu index passed is the handle returned by CreateLUIMenu, usually stored on an entity or in level.
Values are strings or numbers depending on the LUI model field, for example screen coordinates, alpha values, or boolean flags.

api.name: SetLutScriptIndex
api.description: Set lut index from script.

api.name: SetLutVolumeActiveBank
api.description: Set lut volumes active bank bit mask.

api.name: SetMapLatLong
api.description: Sets the map's real world latitude & longitude and their corresponding map coordinates.

parameters.name: mapX
parameters.description: map X coordinate for which the longitude is given.

parameters.name: mapY
parameters.description: map Y coordinate for which the longitude is given.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: world longitude of the given map position.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: world latitude of the given map position.

remarks: The only observed use is in the tactical insertion script, which reads the map coordinates and world coordinates from level data before calling it.

api.name: SetMaterialOverride
api.description: Set the material override.

api.name: SetModel
api.description: Sets the model rendered by a script mover.

calledOn.name: scriptMover
calledOn.description: A script mover.

parameters.name: xmodelName
parameters.description: The name of the XModel to render.

api.name: SetNearestEnemyScrambler
api.description: Set the nearest enemy scrambler.

parameters.name: cent
parameters.description: The client entity of the nearest enemy scrambler.

remarks: The scrambler script recomputes the nearest active enemy scrambler for each local player and pushes the result down with this call.

api.name: SetOverlayConstant
api.description: Set the overlay constant.
remarks: The observed use drives the opacity of a hazmat filter overlay, alongside SetFilterPassConstant for the matching filter.

api.name: SetOverlayEnabled
api.description: Enables or disables the overlay.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client number whose overlay state should be changed.

remarks: Call sites enable the overlay after SetOverlayMaterial has assigned its material, and disable it again when the effect is removed.

api.name: SetOverlayMaterial
api.description: Set the overlay material.
remarks: The material index passed is a previously mapped material id rather than a raw material name.
Paired with SetOverlayEnabled, which turns the configured overlay on or off.

api.name: SetPBGActiveBank
api.description: Set PBG bank mask from script.
remarks: Call sites pass small constant masks (typically 1 or 2) to switch the level between authored per-bank grading looks.

api.name: SetPlayerCybercomAbility
api.description: Sets the cybercom ability for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: abilityName
parameters.description: The name of the cybercom ability.

remarks: The cybercom script calls this on the local player when the selected ability changes.

api.name: SetRenderInThirdPersonSpectate
api.description: render the entity when spectated in 3rd person.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: Enable or disable redering the entity in 3rd person.

api.name: SetRimIntensity
api.description: Global character skin/cloth rim lighting intensity.

api.name: SetRippleWave
api.description: Trigger vertex ripple wave for material set to use it.

parameters.name: fadeInEnd
parameters.description: The fade in at the end.

parameters.name: fadeOutEnd
parameters.description: The fade out at the end.

api.name: SetSAnim
api.description: Set the anim shot to play on a static model.

parameters.name: stringShotName
parameters.description: shot name of the sub animation to play, pass in <int> 0 to play the first one.

parameters.name: floatTime
parameters.description: frame to start playing on, default is 0.

api.name: SetSavedDvar
api.description: Sets a saved dvar.

parameters.name: dvarName
parameters.description: The dvar to set the value of.

api.name: SetScale
api.description: Set the model scale on a script mover.
remarks: Applied to script models and clones as well as movers, including fake pickup models and end game taunt props.
A scale of 0 is used to hide a model, and the original scale is set again to restore it.

api.name: SetScriptStreamBias
api.description: Sets the base importance of materials being forced from script.

parameters.name: bias
parameters.description: Streaming bias (0 is the highest importance).

api.name: SetServerVolumetricFogDensity
api.description: Set the density of server volumetric fog.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time to lerp to the new value.

api.name: Setshaderconstant
api.description: Set the value of a previously-mapped shader constant.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose shader constant is set.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Local client for which to set the shader constant.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: An 0-based index that refers to a previously-mapped shader constant(see MapShaderConstant).

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: A float value, x component of the shader constant.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: A float value, y component of the shader constant.

parameters.name: z
parameters.description: A float value, z component of the shader constant.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: A float value, w component of the shader constant.

remarks: Called on the entity whose material uses the mapped constant, most often to animate a glow value over time in a loop.
The index selects one of the constants previously mapped for that entity; unused components are passed as 0.

api.name: SetShowcaseWeaponPaintshopXUID
api.description: Sets the showcase weapon paintshop XUID for the given local client.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client number to update.

parameters.name: xuid
parameters.description: An optional XUID string. An empty string clears the value.

remarks: When xuid is omitted or empty, the stored showcase paintshop XUID is cleared.

api.name: SetSModelSAnimShot
api.description: Set the anim shot to play on a static model.

parameters.name: targetName
parameters.description: target name of the static model or <int index> The index of the static model or <array int indices> The indices of the static models (string).

parameters.name: shotName
parameters.description: shot name of the sub animation to play, pass in <int> 0 to play the first one. (string).

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: frame to start playing on, pass in -1 to use the static model random frame, this is the default. (float).

parameters.name: loop
parameters.description: this is unused, looping is set in the asset editor. (integer).

parameters.name: append
parameters.description: If !0 the animation will be played after the current animation(s), any loop flags in current animations are ignored. If 0, it will replace the current and any appended animation with the current one.(integer).

parameters.name: blend
parameters.description: If !0 new animation will blend into the new one. default is 0 (integer).

parameters.name: framesToBlend
parameters.description: If number of frames to blend over (float).

api.name: SetSonarAttachmentEnabled
api.description: Set the sonar attachment to be enabled or disabled.

api.name: SetSoundContext
api.description: Sets a global sound context type to a value, changing which aliases the sound system selects.
remarks: Contexts are set once at level or gametype startup, and switched at runtime when the player enters a distinct audio state such as water, a cockpit, or last stand.
SetSoundEntContext applies the same type and value to a single entity instead of globally.

api.name: SetSoundEntContext
api.description: Sets the entity sound context.
remarks: Used to give one entity its own audio state, for example a player over or under water, or an actor moving quietly or loudly.
The global equivalent is SetSoundContext.

api.name: SetSoundPitch
api.description: Set the sound pitch.
remarks: The playback id comes from a looping sound started earlier, typically stored per local client.
Usually followed by SetSoundPitchRate so the pitch change is interpolated rather than instant.

api.name: SetSoundPitchRate
api.description: Set the sound pitch rate.
remarks: Always observed immediately after SetSoundPitch on the same playback id, controlling how quickly the new pitch is reached.

api.name: SetSoundVolume
api.description: Set the sound volume.
remarks: The playback id is the handle of a looping sound started earlier and kept in a variable or on an entity.
Setting the volume to 0 is the common way to fade a loop out before stopping it; SetSoundVolumeRate controls how fast the change happens.

api.name: SetSoundVolumeRate
api.description: Set the sound volume rate.
remarks: Observed only next to SetSoundVolume on the same playback id, so the volume change is interpolated over time.

api.name: SetStepTriggerSound
api.description: Set the sound that is triggered by steps.
remarks: The single call site builds the alias from a trigger's script_label plus a surface suffix, and calls it on the player touching the trigger.

api.name: SetStreamerRequest
api.description: Put a streamer hint asset into a request slot (0-7).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the streamer hint asset.

remarks: Paired with ClearStreamerRequest, which frees the slot again.

api.name: SetStunned
api.description: Puts the vehicle or takes the vehicle out of stun mode.  Only works for nitrous vehicles.
remarks: The observed use is the RC bomb, which sets the stun state to 1 when it is disabled and back to 0 when it recovers.

api.name: SetTeamReviveIcon
api.description: Set the revive icon used by particular teams.

api.name: SetThirdPerson
api.description: Sets the camera mode to third person if true.

parameters.name: onOff
parameters.description: set third person mode to this value.

api.name: SetUIModelValue
api.description: Sets a UIModel from the model being passed in.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model of the value to set.

remarks: The model argument is a handle from GetUIModel or CreateUIModel, often created inline in the same call.
Values are numbers, strings, or localized strings depending on what the LUI element expects.

api.name: SetUkkoScriptIndex
api.description: Set ukko index from script.
remarks: Zombies maps call this several times in sequence with different indices and a blend of 1 while setting up the level's lighting look.

api.name: SetUnderwaterVisionSet
api.description: Set the vision when underwater.

api.name: SetupClientFieldAnimSpeedCallbacks
api.description: Registers a code callback for each of the given clientfield names in a field pool.
remarks: The only observed use registers an actor pool field named anim_rate, so the client field drives the entity's animation speed directly in code.

api.name: Setupclientfieldcodecallbacks
api.description: Registers a LUI code callback for each of the given clientfield names in a field pool.
remarks: Called during client field registration, with the same pool and version used when the field was registered.
Observed pools are toplayer and world, and the field name is often built at runtime from a struct value.

api.name: SetupClientFieldLuiCodeCallbacks
api.description: Registers a LUI code callback for each of the given clientfield names in a field pool.

api.name: SetupFieldOpsKitLoadouts
api.description: Sets up all the field ops custom classes (using slots 6 through 9).

parameters.name: mapname
parameters.description: The map to load the field ops kits for.

api.name: SetWaterDisturbanceParams
api.description: Sets parameters describing the water disturbance created by the (script mover) entity.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: The force of the disturbance influences the height and size of the wave.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: How long the wave is in the direction of travel.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: How wide the wave is (across direction of travel).

parameters.name: damping
parameters.description: How much the wave damps the water after it travels; larger values (>1) will cause the wave to leave very little wake, smaller values will leave lots of disturbance behind the wave.  Keep > 0.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The angle of the surge line in degrees; 0 -> +X.

remarks: The single call site applies it to a script mover that travels through wave water in the Singapore level.

api.name: SetWaveWaterEnabled
api.description: Makes a water completely appear or disappear.

parameters.name: waterName
parameters.description: The name of the water affected, or empty string for all.

remarks: Call sites name a specific water and toggle it with 1 and 0 as the level's water state changes.

api.name: SetWaveWaterHeight
api.description: Sets the height of one or all waters in a level.

parameters.name: waterName
parameters.description: The name of the water affected, or empty string for all.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The new height value in world coordinates.

remarks: The observed use steps the height each frame to animate a named water rising or falling.

api.name: SetWeaponCosts
api.description: Sets the cost of a weapon for use by prompts.

parameters.name: playerAmmoCost
parameters.description: Cost to buy ammo through secret shopper.

api.example: SetWeaponCosts( localClientNum, weaponCost.weapon, weaponCost.cost, weaponCost.ammo_cost, playerCost );
remarks: The zombies weapon script pushes each entry of its weapon cost table down per local client so purchase prompts can display the price.

api.name: SetWeaponRenderOptions
api.description: Sets weapon render options on an entity.
api.example: weaponModel SetWeaponRenderOptions( camoIndex, reticleIndex, showPlayerTag, showEmblem, paintjobIndex, paintjobSlot );
remarks: Applied to the script model that previews a weapon in create a class and the weapon customization view.
The arguments observed are camo index, reticle index, player tag and emblem flags, and paintjob index and slot.

api.name: SetWorldFogActiveBank
api.description: Sets world fog volumes active bank mask.
remarks: The mask is a small power of two selecting one authored fog bank, and is frequently set right before or after SetLitFogBank.

api.name: Show
api.description: Shows (unhides) the given entity.

calledOn.name: target
calledOn.description: The entity to show.

api.name: SiegeCmd
api.description: Apply a number of anim commands on a siege model.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The siege model.

parameters.name: additionalCommands
parameters.description: Zero or more additional commands to execute.

api.name: Sin
api.description: Returns the sin of an angle.

returns.description: The sine of the given angle.

remarks: Commonly paired with Cos to build a position offset around a center point.
Also used with a steadily increasing value such as GetRealTime() to drive oscillating values.

api.name: SModelAnimCmd
api.description: Applies one or more animation commands to the static models with the given targetname.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: target name of the static model or <int index> The index of the static model or <array int indices> The indices of the static models (string).

remarks: Observed commands include "pause", "unpause", "unloop" and "goto_start", which can be chained in a single call.

api.name: SoundLineEmitter
api.description: Play a sound from start point to end point.
remarks: Stopped with SoundStopLineEmitter and moved with SoundUpdateLineEmitter, using the same alias and endpoints.

api.name: SoundLoopEmitter
api.description: Play a sound loop at the position.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The position to play sound at.

remarks: Typically driven by an ambient sound entity's script_sound and origin.
Stopped with SoundStopLoopEmitter using the same alias and position.

api.name: SoundPlayAutoFX
api.description: This function is used to play audio on createfx ents.

parameters.name: fxid
parameters.description: The ID of the FX you want to play alias off.

parameters.name: offsetx
parameters.description: Offset x from effect origin to play the sound.

parameters.name: offsety
parameters.description: Offset y from effect origin to play the sound.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset z from effect origin to play the sound.

parameters.name: onground
parameters.description: Do a trace to ground to ensure audio is played above ground.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: If #threshold multiple effects of same id in target radius #area, play alias_override at center of fx instead.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: If #threshold multiple effects of same id in target radius #area, play alias_override at center of fx instead.

parameters.name: alias_override
parameters.description: If #threshold multiple effects of same id in target radius #area, play alias_override at center of fx instead.

api.name: SoundPlaying
api.description: Returns true if the sound given by sound id is playing.
remarks: Usually polled in a wait loop to block until a played sound has finished.

api.name: SoundRattle
api.description: Set the rattle sound's origin, min distance and max distance.

parameters.name: minDist
parameters.description: The min distance to play sound.

parameters.name: maxDist
parameters.description: The max distance to play sound.

remarks: Observed with a minimum distance of 10 to 250 and a maximum distance of 350 to 800 units.

api.name: SoundRattleSetup
api.description: Play a rattle sound at the position.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The position to play sound at.

remarks: Called once per rattle entity during setup, using the entity's script_sound and origin.

api.name: SoundSetMusicState
api.description: Set the music state for the sound.
remarks: The last state set is cached in script so that it can be restored later.

api.name: SoundStopLineEmitter
api.description: Stops the sound playing from start point to end point.
remarks: Called with the same alias and endpoints that were passed to SoundLineEmitter.

api.name: SoundStopLoopEmitter
api.description: Stop the sound loop emitter at the position.
remarks: Called with the same alias and position that were passed to SoundLoopEmitter.

api.name: SoundTimeScale
api.description: Set the sound time scale.

api.name: SoundUpdateLineEmitter
api.description: Updates the sound playing from previous start point to previous end point.
remarks: Used to move an emitter started by SoundLineEmitter as its endpoints change, passing the previous endpoints so the existing emitter is found.

api.name: Spawn
api.description: Spawns a client-side entity at the given origin. If a type of `script_model` or `script_origin` is provided, the entity is initialized as a script mover.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client number to spawn the entity for.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The position to spawn the entity at.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The entity type. When set to `script_model` or `script_origin`, the entity is initialized as a script mover.

returns.name: entity
returns.description: The spawned entity.

api.name: Spawndynent
api.description: Spawn a dynent.

api.name: SpawnStruct
api.description: Spawns (creates) an empty struct.

returns.name: struct
returns.description: The newly created struct.

api.name: Sphere
api.description: Debug instrument.

api.name: SplitArgs
api.description: Splits a space seperated string, returning an array of each word in the string.

api.name: Sprintf
api.description: Replaces field specifiers in a string with values passed in, returns result string format specifiers take the form of {[n]} in the source string where [n] indicates which value to print, e.g. 0 is the first user arg.
remarks: The format string can be a localized string reference, with the substituted values supplied as extra arguments.

api.name: Sqrt
api.description: Returns the square-root of floating point value <a>.
remarks: Frequently used with VectorDot on a velocity vector to obtain its length.

api.name: StartWaterSheetingFX
api.description: Play a fullscreen water effect.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: Local client on which to play the fx.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The number of seconds to play the fx before it stops automatically. Use 0 for infinite time. Defaults to 0.

remarks: Paired with StopWaterSheetingFX to fade the fullscreen water effect back out.

api.name: StopAllLoopSounds
api.description: Stops all looping sounds playing on the entity, optionally fading them out.

parameters.name: fade
parameters.description: The time in seconds over which the sounds fade out.

remarks: Usually called on a dedicated sound entity when its loop should end.
Observed fade times run from 0.5 to 4 seconds; the argument is omitted for an immediate stop.

api.name: StopExtraCamXCam
api.description: Stops an XCam on the extra cam associated with the entity.

api.name: StopForceStreamingMaterial
api.description: Forces the streamer to load the texture LODs for a material even if it isn't yet visible.  Returns true when all levels are loaded.  Call StopForceStreamingMaterial when you no longer need it, or Steve will be upset that you're wasting Streamer memory.

api.name: StopForceStreamingXModel
api.description: Forces the streamer to load model and texture LODs for a model even if it isn't yet visible.  Returns true when all levels are loaded.  Call StopForceStreamingXModel when you no longer need it, or Steve will be upset that you're wasting Streamer memory.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The name of the model to stop force streaming.

remarks: Called with the same model name that was passed to ForceStreamXModel once the forced LODs are no longer needed.

api.name: StopForcingStreamer
api.description: Remove all streamer forcing.

api.name: StopFX
api.description: Stops a given fx.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client the effect is playing on.

parameters.name: effectId
parameters.description: The effect id returned by playFx.

remarks: The effect id is normally stored on an entity or in a level array when PlayFX is called, then passed back here to stop it.

api.name: StopLoopSound
api.description: Stops the given loop sound on the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity the loop sound is being played on.

parameters.name: loopSoundId
parameters.description: The loop sound handle, which is first returned by a `PlayLoopSound` call.

parameters.name: fadeOutDuration
parameters.description: The fade out duration for the sound.

api.name: StopMainCamXCam
api.description: Stops an XCam on the main cam associated with the entity.

api.name: StopRadiantExploder
api.description: Stop the specified Radiant exploder.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The local client to play the effect on.
